content: Comments saved my life. Also, having the gen 2 and indx guides combined would be amazing.
Had a Hyper link that jumped me from INDX Gen2 to Founders edition...

Jumping back and forth between INDX and GEN 2 was tough.  The hyperlinks didn’t alway land at the correct Steop.  Even a PDF “Road Map” such as -  INDX Steps 1-7, then GEN 2 Steps 3-5, back to INDX 8…….  Could print it out and check them off as you go.

Comments were a big help
